body:
Hi Leonard,

The bridge send list is done. It's "Q4 update - send list" in my Q4 2025 investor update folder, and I've shared it with you. It's as of end of day Tue Sep 30 PT. Counts by group:

- New investor: 0 firms, 1 angel (Anton Bernstein, $25K: his reduced SAFE came back DocuSign Completed on Sep 26)
- In talks: 8 firms (GFR, a16z, Dentsu, T-Accelerate, NCsoft, SciPlay, plus Brightwater Games Fund and Homa, who aren't on the list but had calls on my calendar), 1 angel (Paul Heydon, $50K: said yes but the DocuSign still isn't signed)
- Awaiting reply: 14 firms, 0 angels
- Keep warm: 2 firms (LVP and Hiro Capital), 0 angels

Total: 25 firms and 2 angels. Everyone else on the 2025 list stays off, per your doc. LVP and Hiro are on a new "Keep warm" checklist on the Existing Investor Update card.

Two things to flag for Monday:
1. a16z is in In talks. The speedrun no was the program's decision, and nothing on our bridge thread is a no.
2. Build access: Dentsu and T-Accelerate are iOS only for now. Arthur found the Play investor tester list was never attached to the internal track, and he's fixing it with today's build. The other firms in talks have no internal build access yet.

Thanks,
Fred
